description: Source code implementing name constraints handling for X.509 certificates, including DNS name matching, directory name validation, IP address validation, and parsing of name constraints extensions.

classes.name: NameConstraints
classes.description: Class managing X.509 name constraints extension parsing and validation, including permitted and excluded subtrees for DNS, directory, and IP address names.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a NameConstraints object from extension data.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses the name constraints extension value and initializes the object.

methods.name: IsPermittedCert
methods.description: Checks if a certificate's subject and subjectAltName conform to the name constraints.

methods.name: IsPermittedDNSName
methods.description: Checks if a DNS name is permitted based on the constraints.

methods.name: IsPermittedDirectoryName
methods.description: Checks if a directory name is permitted.

methods.name: IsPermittedIP
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is permitted.
